positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph as asserted by the lead astronomer?
positions.why: Quill Ashgrove's two-part witness statement: the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz (src-1) and that calibration was verified against June reference plates holding across the full observing band (src-2). One continuous assertion split across two segments — the calibration claim and its verification.

positions.name: RecordedCalibrationDecisions
positions.frame: what key decisions were recorded from this observatory calibration session?
positions.why: Xena ExpertGH records the session's key decisions as a structured summary: the header label (src-3) introduces the instrument identity (src-4) and the calibration parameters with verification reference (src-5). Together they form the recorded decision record distilled from Quill's witness assertion.
